passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My favorite fruit is an apple.
phrases.zh: 我最喜欢的水果是苹果。
phrases.py: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de shuǐ guǒ shì píng guǒ。

phrases.en: I wash it first, and I take a big bite.
phrases.ko: 나는 먼저 사과를 씻고, 크게 한 입 베어 물어요.
phrases.zh: 我先把它洗干净，再大咬一口。
phrases.py: wǒ xiān bǎ tā xǐ gān jìng， zài dà yǎo yī kǒu。
yǒu shí wǒ hē guǒ zhī。

phrases.en: I eat fruit as a snack, and I eat fruit every day.
phrases.ko: 나는 과일을 간식으로 먹고, 매일 과일을 먹어요.
phrases.zh: 我把水果当零食，而且每天都吃水果。
phrases.py: wǒ bǎ shuǐ guǒ dāng líng shí， ér qiě měi tiān dōu chī shuǐ guǒ。

phrases.en: A red apple looks sweet before I bite it.
phrases.ko: 빨간 사과는 베어 물기 전에도 달콤해 보여요.
phrases.zh: 我咬之前，红苹果看起来就很甜。
phrases.py: wǒ yǎo zhī qián， hóng píng guǒ kàn qǐ lái jiù hěn tián。

phrases.en: I wash the fruit because clean food is better.
phrases.ko: 깨끗한 음식이 더 좋아서 나는 과일을 씻어요.
phrases.zh: 干净的食物更好，所以我洗水果。
phrases.py: gān jìng de shí wù gèng hǎo， suǒ yǐ wǒ xǐ shuǐ guǒ。

phrases.en: Juice is sweet, but a whole apple is healthier.
phrases.ko: 주스는 달콤하지만, 사과 한 개가 더 건강해요.
phrases.zh: 果汁很甜，可是整个苹果更健康。
phrases.py: guǒ zhī hěn tián， kě shì zhěng gè píng guǒ gèng jiàn kāng。

phrases.en: Every day I put fruit in my schoolbag.
phrases.zh: 我每天把水果放进书包。
phrases.py: wǒ měi tiān bǎ shuǐ guǒ fàng jìn shū bāo。

phrases.en: A healthy snack helps me study.
phrases.zh: 健康的零食帮助我学习。
phrases.py: jiàn kāng de líng shí bāng zhù wǒ xué xí。

full_passage_spoken: My favorite fruit is an apple. It is red and sweet. I wash it first, and I take a big bite. Sometimes I drink juice. An apple is healthy. I eat fruit as a snack, and I eat fruit every day. A red apple looks sweet before I bite it. I wash the fruit because clean food is better. Juice is sweet, but a whole apple is healthier. Every day I put fruit in my schoolbag. A healthy snack helps me study.
topic_pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de shuǐ guǒ
full_passage_zh: 我最喜欢的水果是苹果。它又红又甜。我先把它洗干净，再大咬一口。有时我喝果汁。苹果很健康。我把水果当零食，而且每天都吃水果。我咬之前，红苹果看起来就很甜。干净的食物更好，所以我洗水果。果汁很甜，可是整个苹果更健康。我每天把水果放进书包。健康的零食帮助我学习。
